name: Egypt
blurb: Pyramids, Nile cruises and Red Sea diving.
cities: Cairo
The Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum.
Luxor
Valley of the Kings and Karnak temple.
Dahab
Laid-back Red Sea town famous for diving.
Aswan
Nile felucca rides, Philae temple and trips to Abu Simbel.
Hurghada
Red Sea resorts and easy diving.
Alexandria
A Mediterranean corniche and a modern great library.
Siwa Oasis
Salt lakes and palm groves in the Western Desert.
Abu Mena
The ruins of an early Christian pilgrimage city in the desert.
Pyramids of Giza
The Great Pyramid, the Sphinx and the pyramid fields stretching to Dahshur.
Mount Sinai & St. Catherine's
An ancient desert monastery below the peak where Moses received the Commandments.
Wadi Al-Hitan
Fossil whale skeletons lying in the desert sand.
Sharm El Sheikh
Red Sea reefs, Ras Mohammed National Park and day trips to Mount Sinai.
